::: {#sol-odds-from-joint-probs}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\odds
&= \frac{\Pf{Y = 1 \mid X = x}}{1 - \Pf{Y = 1 \mid X = x}}
&& \text{(definition of odds)}
\\ &= \frac{\Pf{Y = 1 \mid X = x}}{\Pf{Y = 0 \mid X = x}}
&& \text{(the two values of $Y$ have conditional probabilities that sum to 1)}
\\ &= \frac{\Pf{X = x, Y = 1} / \Pf{X = x}}{\Pf{X = x, Y = 0} / \Pf{X = x}}
&& \text{(definition of conditional probability, in numerator and denominator)}
\\ &= \frac{\Pf{X = x, Y = 1}}{\Pf{X = x, Y = 0}}
&& \text{(divide the numerator and the denominator by the same positive number $\Pf{X = x}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
